claim_assessment.question: ORP dose/time mapping
claim_assessment.current_evidence: Section 3.1 lists 6,6,8,11 days for 2,5,8,10 g/L; original Figure 1b places the high-dose curves above the low-dose curve. Do not select corrected crossing times from visual approximation.
claim_assessment.needed: Attributable dose/time worksheet and replicate ORP values.

claim_assessment.question: Sulfur units and kinetic basis
claim_assessment.current_evidence: Methods/Figures use g/L; Table 4 says mg/L. Table 3 heading gives sulfate rate in mg/L while equation 1 and Figure 3 give mg/L/d. Tables and model fits do not resolve the experimental units or growth mechanism.
claim_assessment.needed: Attributable unit correction and fitting input/implementation.

claim_assessment.question: Sampling/inoculum inventory
claim_assessment.current_evidence: Methods 2.4 says two-day intervals; Figures 1/4 have daily markers while Figure 2 has two-day points. Evaporation top-up is stated, but sample withdrawal/replacement and destructive versus repeat allocation are not.
claim_assessment.needed: Sampling volumes, arm/flask/replicate identifiers, final volumes, inoculum mass and cumulative corrections.

claim_assessment.question: Nutrient analytes and mass basis
claim_assessment.current_evidence: Figure 7 axes/methods are TN/TP; caption says nitrate/phosphate. Table 1/Figure 7 TOC mg/kg versus Table 6 carbon wt% remains unreconciled. Concentration decreases do not establish nutrient mass recovery/loss.
claim_assessment.needed: Assay identities, dry/wet bases, residual mass and dissolved/solid/inoculum inventories.

claim_assessment.question: Figure 6 specimen
claim_assessment.current_evidence: Post-treatment sulfur arm is unlabelled. Paired displayed totals cannot supply dose identity or recovery without residue mass. Fractions are operational extraction pools.
claim_assessment.needed: Specimen-to-dose/replicate link and residue mass balance.

claim_assessment.question: Community identity/accessions
claim_assessment.current_evidence: Salt-medium clone enrichment reports 98% similarity, no accession in fresh Heliyon XML or new biochar SI. Main biochar methods unavailable. Targeted sequence searches have limited negative results and one degraded BioProject query; no verified match.
claim_assessment.needed: Full cited clone protocol, clone sequences/accession versions and link to the actual manure inoculum and assay.

claim_assessment.question: Controls, product and field use
claim_assessment.current_evidence: All four sulfur-dose arms inoculated; no matched sterile/uninoculated/zero-sulfur/acid control shown. New SI biochar arms are separate.
claim_assessment.needed: Matched controls and product/field measurements before such claims.

biochar_context.role: Cited protocol lead; new original supplement context only
biochar_context.S1: All 20 fraction cells inspected. Cu organic/sulfides 64.8, Zn mobile sum 65.6 and Mn mobile sum 72.7 match Heliyon prose; Cu organic/sulfide plus residual =72.0 versus Heliyon 73. Visually similar Figure 6a does not establish batch identity.
biochar_context.S2: All 18 mean/dispersion cells inspected. Under equal-volume ratio-of-means calculation TN 180.3→156.3 gives13.311%, printed4.3%; NH4-N10.4→8.2 gives21.154%, printed8.8%. Original replicate normalization unavailable; preserve both, no correction chosen. DOC/ON/TP are consistent to reported precision; nitrate ratio-of-means4.811 versus printed4.1 can be affected by uncertainty. N species concentration means sum to the printed TN in both columns.
biochar_context.figures: S1 is DOC in mg/L for Fc/Fb through day5, not the Heliyon TOC mg/kg assay. S2 plots raw/Fc/Fb XRD; do not transfer labelled phase assignments to the sulfur-only Figure6 specimen or infer isolated product.
biochar_context.sequence: No sequence accession in inspected supplement. Full main methods remain required.
